SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Mill.]
Nosebleed : congestion to chest and head ; excessive.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Mill.]
Urine bloody ; blood forms a cake in vessel.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Mill.]
Menses excessive, last too long, with colic.
Uterine hemorrhages ; after great exertion ; miscarriage.
   

COUGH. [27] [Mill.]
Hæmoptysis : in incipient phthisis (after Acon. and Arn.) ; in hemorrhoidal patients ; from a rupture of bloodvessel ; after injury.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Mill.]
Hemorrhages of all kinds, mostly from lungs and bowels ; florid ; of mechanical origin ; atonic constitutions ; of wounds.
